title: Bonds
intro: Link aggregation: bond interfaces (BondEthernet<id>) with their member NICs, and live member / LACP state from the data plane. Changes go to the candidate and apply on Commit.
addHelp: A bond is named BondEthernet<id>. Add members after creating it; the bond's addresses, MTU and VLANs are set on the Interfaces page like any interface's.
addFailed: The bond could not be added to the candidate.
readonly: Your role can view but not change the configuration.

drawer.label: Bond {{name}}
drawer.notInVpp: VPP has no such bond (yet). It is created on Commit.
drawer.noLive: The agent does not report live bond state; only the configuration is shown.
drawer.interfaceHint: Admin state, MTU, MAC, addresses, VRF and VLAN sub-interfaces of the bond are edited like any interface's:
drawer.notConfigured: This bond is not in the candidate configuration.
drawer.saved: Saved to the candidate. Commit to apply.

members.title: Members
members.noneEligible: No eligible interface (NICs without addresses, not in another bond)

mode.title: Mode
mode.help: lacp (802.3ad), xor, round-robin or active-backup; changing it re-creates the bond

loadBalance.title: Load balance
loadBalance.help: xor and lacp only: transmit hash over l2 (MAC), l23 (MAC+IP) or l34 (IP+port); absent = l2

numaOnly.title: NUMA-local members only
numaOnly.help: transmit only on members attached to the bond's NUMA node

id.title: Bond ID
id.help: absent = the number in the interface name (BondEthernet<id>)

passive.title: Passive
passive.help: LACP only: do not initiate LACP; the partner must be active

longTimeout.title: Long timeout
longTimeout.help: LACP only: 90 s partner timeout (slow LACPDUs) instead of 3 s

weight.title: Weight
weight.help: active-backup only: the up member with the highest weight is active (1–255)
